notes.title: Choc N Roll - Update 1: Achievements, New Tiles, Updated Visuals & More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We are excited to announce that Update 1 for Choc N Roll is now out! Here's a list of everything we added in this version:

 20 Achievements
 New Tiles
 Optimisation
 Bug Fixes
 Art assets updated 

Thank you to everyone who has bought and wishlisted the game so far! We really appreciate it :)! To celebrate these additions to the game, Choc N Roll is currently 30% OFF as part of Steam's Spring Sale!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795255/e1e5e38dd415d434766bbec0ffadfca6a32452ba.png

Next update we'll be adding leaderboards, as well as fixing any bugs and further optimisation! We've also been working hard on some of our other game titles, so if any of them sound interesting to you, then feel free to check them out - below are links to those if you're interested.

Escalar: The Tower of Treasures - An adventure precision platformer, with collectathon and puzzle elements. Climb a mysterious tower to reach the rumoured treasures that lie within!
Cosmic Kitchen - A 2D cooking game set in space! Your mission: Feed hungry monsters or else they will take over all the galaxies!
Washed Upon a Murder - After washing onto a private island, you soon find yourself in the middle of a murder mystery puzzle. The worst part? Everyone thinks you've dunnit!


- Skyline Studios Games
